recommendation.headline: Accept the dispute and issue a full refund since the buyer received a damaged item (chipped rim).
recommendation.rationale: Although the buyer selected 'merchandise not received' as the dispute reason, store records and customer messages clearly show the item was delivered but arrived damaged (one chipped mug). Per shop policy, damaged items qualify for a full refund without return shipping costs. Accepting the claim and issuing a refund saves time and aligns with customer service standards.
